title: smtp: STARTTLS via rustls (port 587)
description: Implement STARTTLS upgrade in crates/smtp/src/session.rs. If TLS is configured (cert_path + key_path set): include STARTTLS in EHLO capabilities. On STARTTLS command: send 220 Go ahead, call load_tls_config(cert, key) → ServerConfig, wrap stream with tokio_rustls::TlsAcceptor::accept(), resume session loop on upgraded stream. Reuse the TLS loading pattern from crates/reader/src/tls.rs — read that file first. If TLS not configured: 454 TLS not available. Tests: STARTTLS when not configured returns 454. (Full TLS handshake test is integration-only — unit test just verifies the 454 path.)
